change_request_projection.normative_rule: 일반 활동원본은 보행 중 전송하지 않는다. 사용자가 이동통신망 전송을 명시적으로 선택한 경우 보행이 정지한 뒤 허용된 이동통신망으로 전송할 수 있으며, 선택하지 않은 경우에는 Wi-Fi에서만 전송한다.

covered_internal_rules: walking blocks activity-original upload on every network
stationary Wi-Fi permits the activity-original upload branch
stationary cellular requires explicit cellular opt-in
unspecified preference falls back to Wi-Fi-only queueing
OTHER and OFFLINE fail closed for the activity-original upload branch
inactive session or unknown motion evidence fails closed even on Wi-Fi
stationary evidence requires an observation window without a new step
a new step returns the evidence state to walking and cancels in-flight work
admission check and enqueue are atomic with concurrent close and cancellation
close and cancellation before admission prevent check and enqueue
inactive transition closes admission and cancels from confirmed stationary state
the first sensor sample closes admission and starts a new stationary evidence window
tracking stop closes admission, resets motion evidence and cancels both uploaders
tracking restart requires a new first sensor sample before stationary admission
walk start or resume invalidates scheduled work and cancels the active HTTP connection
